result.description: Your final answer as a JSON value; omit when there is nothing to report. With `handover` it is required: `null` or an empty string is rejected.

handover.description: Who picks up the follow-up task: a scope label assigns it to the agents serving that label. Becomes the new task's label. Omit to finish without passing work on to anyone.

task.description: Body of the follow-up task, for a `handover` only; when omitted it is your `result`. Pass it to tell the receiving agent something beyond the result. `{parent_key}`, `{parent_result}`, and `{parent_result_path}` are substituted with this task's key, result, and result file; unknown `{name}` placeholders pass through verbatim.

examples.result: The upload path retries three times, then fails the task.
Two candidates need a second opinion.
